bathymetry.retrieval: Original metadata HTTP 200; local original archive checksum verified
bathymetry.depth_claim: Nominal source-datum depths only; 91.44 m coverage ceiling, fine-detail extraction strictly shallower than 80 m. Delivered 2 m pixels below 80 m originate from a 5 m grid.
bathymetry.accuracy: Unknown quantitative horizontal/vertical accuracy; grid spacing is not sounding accuracy.
bathymetry.interpolation: Gridded multibeam; explicit interpolation mask unavailable. Unknown filled cells are not claimed measured soundings.

classes.1: soft and flat fine grain sedimented seafloor
classes.2: hard and flat coarse grain sediment and bedrock seafloor
classes.3: hard and rugose boulder, megaclast, and bedrock seafloor

substrate.metadata_caveat: Catalog ground-condition year 2011 and metadata 10 m spacing do not establish acoustic/video acquisition dates or actual pixel spacing. Actual raster spacing is 2 m; depth-dependent coarsening inherited from bathymetry remains masked.
substrate.evidence_claim: Sonar-derived substrate interpretation using paired bathymetry/backscatter plus video supervision; not independent bathymetric corroboration or fish-presence evidence.
